whenToUse: Short groups of text, such as new feature introductions or empty state notices.
Key phrases when a screen first opens.
As the default when other effects look excessive.
whenNotToUse: Text people are already reading changes (change it in place).
Large movements that rise a long way.
Applying it to every element across the board.

alternatives.name: Blur In
alternatives.reason: Giving a feeling of coming into focus.

accessibility: Text is in the document from the start, so screen readers don't wait.
With reduced motion, only opacity changes, without movement.
The distance is set with a CSS variable, 12px by default.
Each element starts 120ms after the last, keeping it short.
